summary: Tested the 13 real-Vapi-call fixes with a new suite, /app/backend/tests/test_call_fixes.py: 18 one-per-fix tests (some parametrized) plus 1 gap test. All 13 fixes pass. Real sentence: priced after 2 questions; sinks never asked; range 25% with 16 assumptions. wants_price and quote/price/how much work. No stairs or fan_count facts in the bathroom; the pendant maps to Exhaust fan and lights; no duplicate lighting or floor tasks. The 'To be priced by Apex' line has amount null in lines, quote line_items, to_be_priced and next_text. The floating small vanity is resolved from what was said. Numeric and categorical confirm thresholds work. fan_vents_outside, hood_vents_outside and cast_iron are never asked (show when the camera is on, otherwise assumed with '(confirmed at the site visit)'). No carpet in bathroom prompts. Insights are delivered exactly once across the ?live=1 poll and update_scope, and GET without live never claims them. The plain-sentence insight matches exactly with (+$650). Real Percia run (1 Gemini pass, 8 s mp4 from bathroom_vanity.mov): 3 goals on the same media, done within 0.8 s of each other; first finding 21.4 s after upload (target 30 s). Old suites: updated the 5 superseded assertions, and 38/38 pass serially. test_media_percia.py: 14/14 pass serially. Dashboard drawer shows 'To be priced' for the null-amount line (UI verified). One real gap: when the camera is off, camera-first priority-1 facts (floor_area, wall_area) are silently defaulted and never measured.

critical.issue: With camera_on=false, floor_area and wall_area (ladder [camera, measure, assume]) go to state waiting_on_camera at idx 0, because enter() never skips 'camera' when the camera is off. next_action ignores waiting_on_camera facts and finalize() assumes the defaults (60 sq ft and 400 sq ft). So 'I want a new tile floor' with the camera off is priced at once with floor_area=60, never measured. Floor tile swings about $1,320 between 30 and 120 sq ft and paint about $1,600, so both are priority-1 facts and should block the price. The 5-question budget is left mostly unused (the real sentence asked only 2 questions). Failing test: test_fix1_camera_off_priority1_floor_area_measured.

minor.issue: What the homeowner said about the floor material is ignored. 'replace the tiles with hardwood floors' in a bathroom is priced as Floor tile (no material fact). 'I want new carpet' and 'I want new hardwood floors in the kitchen' create Flooring with floor_new assumed 'vinyl', because floor_new has no from_said and isn't asked (impact < $1,000). The quote contradicts the stated material.

A fact assumed from its default (e.g. replacing_vanity after 'not sure') adds New vanity through a rule. That task's implies then re-resolve the same fact with basis 'said'. The assumption disappears from the assumptions list, the range narrows, and the fact looks like the homeowner said it. apply_implies should skip facts in state 'assumed' whose source is a rule-added item.

When the camera confirms a default that was already priced (camera on and the price given before the camera answered, the usual case now that only priority-1 facts block), no item is 'added'. The insight is then only 'Single-sink vanity standing on the floor', with no '; the tile under it will need patching'. The full sentence only appears if the camera result arrives before pricing.
range_pct is not returned in turn or update_scope results (only inside the quote). Fine for the spec, but useful for Alex and for tests.

integration_issues.issue: ChatScreen calls useLiveQuote(token, data.quote) without the adapter, but still polls ?live=1. Any undelivered insight is claimed (marked delivered) and dropped. Low impact because chat has no camera, but insights from an earlier camera call or from goal callbacks would be lost. Either pass the adapter or don't send live=1.
If the poll claims an insight after 'ended' is true, or before Vapi has connected, the insight is dropped but stays marked delivered on the server.

action_items: HIGH: In Itemizer.enter() (or next_action), when camera_on is false, skip the 'camera' rung so camera-first priority-1 facts (floor_area, wall_area) move to 'measure' and are asked within the 5-question budget. Re-run test_fix1_camera_off_priority1_floor_area_measured.

Capture the stated floor material: add from_said to floor_new (hardwood/carpet/tile/vinyl) and handle 'hardwood' in a bathroom (Floor tile has no material fact, so it is priced as tile even when the homeowner says hardwood).
apply_implies should not override assumed facts. Keep the assumption so the range stays honest.
Optional: when the camera confirms an assumed value that triggered an auto item (e.g. Retile), still include the item's 'because' clause in the insight.
ChatScreen: pass the adapter to useLiveQuote, or poll without live=1.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.py is 616 lines and close to the 700-line limit. Consider splitting the pricing and insight code out.

In test_media_percia.py, TestPercia depends on lead['m0'] set by TestMedia on another worker (KeyError). Both pass with -n 0. Put dependent classes in one class, or use a module-level fixture for the uploaded media.

rca of the issue: Camera-off gap: Itemizer.enter() handles ch=='show' when the camera is off (skips it) but not ch=='camera'. It marks the fact waiting_on_camera and appends a camera attempt. next_action only looks at facts in state open or asked, so the fact is never asked. finalize() then assumes the default with camera_pending=True. Repro: POST /api/itemizer/{id}/turn {said:'I want a new tile floor', answers:{finish_level:'standard',water_damage:'no',timeline:'in two months'}, camera_on:false} returns status ok with 'Assumed floor area (sq ft): 60'. Fix: in enter(), when ch=='camera' and not camera_on, f['idx'] += 1 and continue, but still let camera.send_goals pick it up if the camera turns on later (at_camera already handles assumed+camera_pending only for camera/show channels).
